title: Sigma representation of sparse Fourier hypotheses
statement: For each natural number $n$, a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $	ext{Fin}(n)$ is equivalent to a pair consisting of a finite family of subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$ and a rational-valued function on that family.
